answer: Resist sybils with a counterpart-diversity gate: an identity earns grading weight only after it settles paid work with 12 distinct established counterparties across three epochs, each trade recorded on-ledger. A farm that plants a garden of clones can copy one controller, but it cannot cheaply invent 12 independent trading histories. A zephyr of one-off pings does not count; each counterpart must clear a median-size floor. Eligibility is published as a public sonnet of those 12 settlement txids, so peers can audit and slash recycled counterpart rings.
